The three R13 bypasses are: (1) covered() returns false whenever the hit element contains the text node (snapshot.js:226 `e.contains(p)`), so text with a negative z-index under its own ancestor's opaque background is kept; (2) the paint-alpha check reads only webkitTextFillColor/color (snapshot.js:240), never SVG fill/fill-opacity, so <text fill=transparent|none> or fill-opacity=0 passes; (3) masked() reads only maskImage/webkitMaskImage (snapshot.js:105), never webkitMaskBoxImage or mask-border. The leaked text then reaches the Brain labelled 'Visible text' and 'Selected text' (bridge.py:61-66), while docs/assist/03:77 claims hidden text is dropped in page and lists a 'Not covered' set that omits these cases.
